list.name: channel
list.label: Canal
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT channel FROM v_user_activity_audit ORDER BY channel

list.name: user_role
list.label: Rôle
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT user_role FROM v_user_activity_audit WHERE user_role IS NOT NULL ORDER BY user_role

list.name: category
list.label: Catégorie
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT action_category FROM v_user_activity_audit ORDER BY action_category

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM v_user_activity_audit WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND channel IN (${channel:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(user_role, 'none') IN (${user_role:sqlstring}) AND action_category IN (${category:sqlstring})
SELECT count(*) FROM v_user_activity_audit WHERE action='LOGIN_SUCCESS' AND created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND channel IN (${channel:sqlstring})

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM v_user_activity_audit WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND channel IN (${channel:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(user_role, 'none') IN (${user_role:sqlstring})
SELECT count(*) FROM v_user_activity_audit WHERE action_category='delete' AND created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
SELECT count(*) FROM v_user_activity_audit WHERE action_category='rbac' AND created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel='mobile') * 100.0 / NULLIF(count(*), 0))::numeric(10,2) AS pct FROM v_user_activity_audit WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

SELECT action_category AS category, count(*) AS n FROM v_user_activity_audit WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND channel IN (${channel:sqlstring}) GROUP BY action_category ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT channel, count(*) AS n FROM v_user_activity_audit WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY channel ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT COALESCE(user_role, '(anonyme)') AS role, count(*) AS n FROM v_user_activity_audit WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND channel IN (${channel:sqlstring}) GROUP BY user_role ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE(user_email, '(anonyme)') AS "Email", COALESCE(user_name, '-') AS "Nom", user_role AS "Rôle", count(*) AS "Actions", count(DISTINCT action) AS "Actions distinctes", min(created_at) AS "Première", max(created_at) AS "Dernière" FROM v_user_activity_audit WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND channel IN (${channel:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(user_role, 'none') IN (${user_role:sqlstring}) GROUP BY user_email, user_name, user_role ORDER BY "Actions" DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT action AS "Action", action_category AS "Catégorie", count(*) AS "Volume", count(DISTINCT user_id) AS "Utilisateurs uniques" FROM v_user_activity_audit WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND channel IN (${channel:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(user_role, 'none') IN (${user_role:sqlstring}) AND action_category IN (${category:sqlstring}) GROUP BY action, action_category ORDER BY "Volume" DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, channel, count(*) AS n FROM v_user_activity_audit WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE action='LOGIN_SUCCESS') AS "Login OK", count(*) FILTER (WHERE action ILIKE 'LOGIN%FAIL%' OR action ILIKE 'LOGIN%ERROR%') AS "Login échec", count(*) FILTER (WHERE action='LOGOUT') AS "Logout" FROM v_user_activity_audit WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT created_at AS "Date", COALESCE(user_email, '(anonyme)') AS "User", user_role AS "Rôle", channel AS "Canal", action AS "Action", action_category AS "Catégorie", entity_type AS "Entité", ip_address AS "IP" FROM v_user_activity_audit WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND channel IN (${channel:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(user_role, 'none') IN (${user_role:sqlstring}) AND action_category IN (${category:sqlstring}) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
